Name: I'm Really Busy Today
Author: secsky3
Description:
# 🌾 I'm Really Busy Today - Postpone Cutscenes & Heart Events

> **"I just need to buy seeds and hit the mines today—I'm really busy, don't trap me in a 5-minute cutscene!"**

Have you ever rushed into town to buy seeds on Day 1 of a season, only to get ambushed by an unexpected 5-minute heart event that completely ruins your farming schedule? 
**I'm Really Busy Today** gives you full control over your time by letting you postpone flexible cutscenes and friendship events to a more relaxing day, while safely preserving critical date-fixed events like festivals, weddings, and story milestones!

---

### ✨ Key Features

* 📜 **Morning Event Briefing** 
  Wake up each morning to an optional, elegant parchment bulletin informing you if any heart events or story cutscenes are possible today, including locations, NPC names, and required heart levels.

* ⏳ **Postpone Events on Demand** 
  Mark yourself as "Busy" for the day. Any friendship or flexible map events you walk into will be silently postponed—they won't trigger today, but will remain ready to trigger whenever you visit again on a free day!

* 🔥 **Interactive Fireplace Divination** 
  Forgot to set your status in the morning? Click any fireplace in your farmhouse 3 times to consult the hearth fire and toggle your "Busy" status anytime!

* 🛡️ **Essential Event Safeguards** 
  Never worry about missing crucial game milestones. Fixed-date events—such as **Festivals, Weddings, Joja/Community Center completions, Pet adoptions, and Passing out**—are guaranteed to trigger normally even when you are busy!

* ⌨️ **Configurable Hotkey & GMCM Integration** 
  Toggle busy mode instantly with a customizable hotkey, or configure all settings through the [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098).

---

### 🎮 In-Game Controls & Commands

| Action | Default Input | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Hearth Interaction** | Click Fireplace 3x | Opens the I'm Really Busy Today dialog menu |
| **Console Command** | `busy` | Toggles busy mode on/off via SMAPI console |
| **Hotkey Toggle** | None (Configurable) | Set your preferred toggle key in GMCM or `config.json` |

---

### ⚙️ Configuration (`config.json`)

```json
{
  "EnableMorningPrompt": true,
  "EnableFireplaceInteraction": true,
  "FireplaceClickCount": 3,
  "ToggleKey": "None"
}
